subject: Region anchoring timeline & subprocessor routing — contract amendment questions
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finwell.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@finwell.com
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Region anchoring ask + DPA amendment timeline

Hi Stephanie / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — FinWell’s engineering and legal teams reviewed the hosting options and we have two concrete asks before procurement can finish SOW sign-off:

1) Can Redwood commit to region anchoring for APAC (data-at-rest + KMS within APAC) with a documented transient failover window for disaster recovery?
2) We need a full subprocessor roster and an expected timeline for any subprocessor additions over the next 12 months.

If possible, please share a short timeline for a DPA amendment (we'd like to put the amendment into our contract queue next week). I've attached a high-level list of the procurement checklist items we need.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform, FinWell
attachments: procurement_checklist_finwell.pdf (pdf)
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finwell.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-19T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Region anchoring ask + DPA amendment timeline

Alex — thanks, and great to hear the demo landed. Quick answers and a proposed next-step plan: 

High-level answers: 
- Region anchoring: we can provide APAC anchoring for customer data-at-rest and a KMS option with keys residing in that region; we will include explicit language in the DPA amendment.
- Transient failover: we support a configurable transient-failover window (default 72 hours) for cross-region processing during incident recovery; we can narrow this if you need a shorter SLA-bound window.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a living roster; I can share the current roster and a quarterly cadence for notification of additions.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (9/19): We send DPA redlines that include APAC anchoring language + transient-failover clause.
- 9/21: FinWell legal sends redline comments.
- 9/23: Redwood legal finalizes amendment draft and prepares DocuSign envelope.
- 9/24–9/28: Procurement signature window (your timeline).

Action items for you: please confirm whether the 72-hour transient window is acceptable or if you require a hard 24-hour cap. Also, do you need per-region KMS separation (APAC-only keys) or is a regional-primary with escrow acceptable?

Attaching: DPA_redlines_v3.pdf and subprocessor_roster_request.xlsx — these are draft redlines and the format we prefer for the roster.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415 555 0123
From: Mia Chen <mia.chen@finwell.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finwell.com>, procurement@finwell.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Region anchoring ask + DPA amendment timeline

Stephanie / Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifying points from Legal: 

- The customer-side requirement is strict: APAC-residency must include both primary storage and KMS keys logically bound to APAC tenancy. We understand transient failover for incidents is necessary, but we need a defined maximum window and an obligation to notify within 1 hour of any cross-region processing event.
- For subprocessors we need: current roster + classification (access/no-access to plaintext), and a 30-day notice for any new subprocessor addition.
- Please confirm whether telemetry/audit logs will be retained in-region or if they will be routed to a central analytics cluster (we prefer in-region retention where possible).

If you can update the draft with: (a) 72-hour vs 24-hour option explicitly called out, (b) notification SLA for transient cross-region processing, and (c) subprocessor classification table, we can aim to get legal sign-off the same week.

Best,
Mia Chen
Senior Counsel, FinWell
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Mia Chen <mia.chen@finwell.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finwell.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Region anchoring ask + DPA amendment timeline

Mia — quick ops confirmation from my side: 
- KMS: we can offer a customer-managed KMS in APAC (BYOK) or a Redwood-managed regional KMS where the key material is stored in-region. BYOK requires a short onboarding window (~5 business days).
- Telemetry: audit logs for region-anchored tenants can be retained within APAC; we will need to scope analytics features that require aggregated telemetry (those can be opt-in and routed to an EU/US analytics cluster on request).
- Notification: we can commit to a 1-hour incident notification SLA for any event that triggers cross-region processing and to provide a root-cause summary within 72 hours.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the exact draft language.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Product Ops, Redwood Inference

- 9/23: FinWell Legal returns any remaining redlines.
